Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises that can give quick AND long-lasting relief for neck and upper back pain.

As a bonus, all of the exercises can be done at home, require no special equipment, and may give relief within 30 seconds.

Watch now and quickly get rid of neck and upper back pain!
